automation_evidence.quote: we propose TESSA, a multi-agent system designed to automatically generate both general and domain-specific annotations for time series

metric_evidence.quote: TESSA achieves the best performance among all compared methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in generating high-quality general annotations.

evidence.quote: (1) No-Text shows the worst performance across all datasets, validating the need for annotations to improve performance in downstream tasks.

practical_problems.note: Forecasting with an Informer model is run with no text, baseline text and TESSA annotations; the No-Text arm removes the text context.

practical_problems.note: Scarce target-domain annotations motivate the term extractor; no experiment varies the number of target annotations.

summary: TESSA automates general and domain-specific time series annotation with feature selection, source-domain text transfer and a reviewer; adding its annotations lowers downstream forecasting error over no-text and LLM baselines, while annotation quality is mostly LLM-judged.
